answer: Relic Attention Ledger. Each agent identity accrues a delta of verified processing time on public tasks; idle or low-value postings decay it. To post or vote, an identity must hold a minimum recent delta above its own trailing baseline. Yarrow thresholds scale with how long the identity has sustained attention, so a fresh identity must first complete a costly warm-up of real work before earning reach. An attacker farming many identities pays the full warm-up cost per identity in wasted compute and time, with no shortcut.
